## What is Git??

 * Git is software which tracks changes in code
 * Create checkpoints known as **commits**
 * Create **branches** for safe experimentation
 * **Merge** changes into your main branch

 
 ![](https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYmIxNDl1dHVqang3dnVjZ3VpbmcydTFrbDB3cmNtZG93dzQ3bWVwMyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/JQRbV7nkeSHmUltCWK/giphy.gif){fig-align="center"}

## GitHub?? GitLab?? GitLost??
 
 * GitHub, GitLab, BitBucket are all flavours of the same thing
 * Host your code online for storage and sharing
 * Free, student, premium and enterprise versions
 * Offer project management and code quality tooling
 
  ![](https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbm80amsydXUxaWVjdmF0N2NhMDM0dDJwcm03amZpNW8yOHd2bWRzMiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/wbp3YSoF7FhT3XyjeE/giphy.gif){fig-align="center"}
  
  
## What can I Git out of GitHub??

 * Collaboration: code review, open source, licensing
 * Project management: issues, boards, discussions
 * CI/CD: run automated checks on your code
 * Wikis: documentation, SOPs, FAQs, ...
 

 ![](https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExN3NleWd0eHBtbnhvb2N1cWl4eDE0dWE5N3Z3eXFxc3p1OGlqZmU0aCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/d6xAHHirkPBTJlaGE5/giphy.gif){fig-align="center"}

## What is this Git trying to get across??

 * Git is version control software
 * GitHub is an online platform for managing code projects
 * You can use CLI and GUIs for Git
 * Start off small, the fancy stuff can come later
 
![](https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExazQ0NGcydDlkaDkzcDEzdDhhdmp5ZmluOHBidjIwYzdhem41bXBuMyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/dsKnRuALlWsZG/giphy.gif){fig-align="center"}
